events.strFilename: IMSA SportsCar Championship 2026-01-25 Rolex 24 At DAYTONA
events.strDescriptionEN: The Rolex 24 At Daytona is the prestigious season-opening endurance race for the IMSA SportsCar Championship, held annually at Daytona International Speedway in late January, featuring multiple classes (GTP, LMP2, GTD PRO, GTD) of top-tier sports cars competing for 24 hours, blending professional drivers with open-wheel and NASCAR stars in a grueling test of endurance and strategy. The 2026 event, the 64th running, takes place January 22-25, kicking off the IMSA season and showcasing various manufacturers and drivers for North America's premier sports car event,.
